# Use Ubuntu 22.04 LTS as base image with bash and stable environment
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC

# Set bash as default shell explicitly
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install essential system dependencies and Python 3.10 (chosen among versions available)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    wget \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    build-essential \
    python3.10 \
    python3.10-venv \
    python3.10-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    python3-setuptools \
    python3-wheel \
    locales \
    locales-all \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Upgrade pip and setuptools to ensure latest packaging support
RUN python3.10 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Create a virtual environment called testbed using python3.10
RUN python3.10 -m venv /opt/testbed

# Add virtual environment to PATH for subsequent commands
ENV PATH="/opt/testbed/bin:$PATH"

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Clone the repository and checkout the specific commit SHA (provided by user)
RUN git clone https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope.git /testbed && \
    git reset --hard f93b928219f5218a93f1651dc7ba486794061860

# Install the repository in editable mode with [full] extra dependencies and additional ones: setuptools, wheel, coverage
# According to context retrieval agent, the recommended way is pip install -e .[full] and the additional packages
RUN /bin/bash -c "pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel coverage && \
    pip install -e .[full]"

# Set bash as default shell for runtime
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Export environment variables placeholders (optional runtime usage)
ENV OPENAI_API_KEY=""
ENV OPENAI_ORGANIZATION=""

# Reaffirm working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/
